thread:
Priya: Quick thread  planning a header-driven cutover for EU model-v2 focusing on reproducibility and safe rollforward. Proposal: use X-RW-Slice and X-RW-Tenant headers, three-phase ramp (QA slices -> deterministic tenant cohorts -> pct ramp), 4h shadow at 6% and automated rollback gates.
Ibrahim: Strong +1 for deterministic slices. Suggest naming convention slice:qa-<n>, slice:phase1-<n> so QA can replay exact traffic. Also expose X-RW-Debug: force-slice for support.
Nina: Rollback gates: automated rollback if error_rate >0.75% for 4m OR p95 latency >300ms above baseline for 8m OR token_cost >25% sustained 10m. On trigger, flip affected slice(s) to compat-model-v1 and mark "quarantined".
Chris: Circuit behavior: after automated rollback open slice-level circuit for 60m and block auto-promote for 3h. Region-wide rollback opens 2h circuit and requires manual re-eval. All automated events emit rollout-audit entries and notify #incidents.
Priya: Shadowing: async mirror with header X-RW-Shadow=true. Store shadow outputs to shadow-index and compute embedding cosine drift + rerank delta. Trigger warning if mean rerank shift >0.12 on sample set.
Ibrahim: Flag schema: eu_model_v2 => {mode: header|cohort|pct, value, allowlist, exempt_enterprise, shadow_pct}. Console should show per-tenant variant and quarantined status.
Nina: Health probes: add /health?variant=v2 returning version, kv_cache_hit, last_1m_p95. k8s readiness should use it. Also cap instance qps for warmup 10m after promotion.
Priya: Action items: 1) Priya to write RFC with exact slice ids and tenant cohorts (due tomorrow). 2) Ibrahim to add header routing + debug header. 3) Chris to implement circuit automation + rollout-audit hooks. 4) Nina to add health probe + warmup limiter and run shadow cost calc.
SRE-Bot: rollout-job-12345 started: applying header rules and flag eu_model_v2 mode=header value=10%. apply-step-1 OK.
